verdict.rationale: Firebase Cloud Functions explicitly support autonomous, event-driven background execution, including triggers from Firebase/Cloud events, HTTPS requests, and Cloud Scheduler jobs, letting users run scheduled or event-triggered automations without manual intervention. Docs also show one-command deployment and auto-scaling for these functions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of scheduler reliability and any dispute resolution for the older community complaint about lacking scheduled tasks (which predates Cloud Scheduler support).
